chapter.name: The Other Side of Zero
hard_words: integer (define it: a whole number, its negative, or zero)
negative number (define it: a number less than zero)
opposite (define it: the same distance from zero on the other side)
number line (define it: a straight line of evenly spaced numbers)

b: two interleaved patterns, 3,2,1,0,−1,−2 going down and 4,5,6,7,8 going up

items.question: Here are six integer cards: (+1), (+7), (+18), (−5), (−2), (−9). You can pick any of these and make an expression using addition(s) and subtraction(s). Here is an expression: (+18) + (+1) − (+7) − (−2) which gives a value (+14). Now, pick cards and make an expression such that its value is closer to (−30).

The sum of two positive integers is always positive but a (positive integer) − (positive integer) can be positive or negative. What about a. (positive) − (negative)  b. (positive) + (negative)  c. (negative) + (negative)  d. (negative) − (negative)  e. (negative) − (positive)  f. (negative) + (positive) a) (positive) − (negative) b) (positive) + (negative) c) (negative) + (negative) d) (negative) − (negative) e) (negative) − (positive) f) (negative) + (positive)
items.answer: a. positive; b. can be positive or negative; c. negative; d. can be positive or negative; e. negative; f. can be positive or negative

videos.answer: a. positive; b. can be positive or negative; c. negative; d. can be positive or negative; e. negative; f. can be positive or negative

items.question: This string has a total of 100 tokens arranged in a particular pattern. What is the value of the string?
steps: Pattern repeats: 3 green (+) tokens then 2 red (−) tokens, 5 tokens per block
100 tokens = 20 blocks
Each block has value 3 − 2 = +1, so total = 20

items.question: Two-player game. Each player has 1 pawn; both start at 0. Players can reach either −50 or +50 to win but need not decide this before or during play. Each player rolls two dice at a time, one with +1 to +6 and the other with −1 to −6. After each roll the player can add or subtract them in any order and then move the steps that indicate the result. A positive result means moving towards +50 and a negative result towards −50.
steps: Roll the +1 to +6 die and the −1 to −6 die.
Add or subtract the two numbers in either order.
Move that many steps: towards +50 if positive, towards −50 if negative.
items.answer: Play the game: the first pawn to reach +50 or −50 wins.
